targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Total KPI Measurements",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success IS DISTINCT FROM true) AS "Failures",
  ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN success = true THEN 1 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 2) AS "Success Rate"
FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ','))) AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM script_results sr_env WHERE sr_env.id = execution_results.script_result_id AND sr_env.environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ','))))) execution_results
WHERE (kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL) AND $__timeFilter(executed_at) AND (COALESCE(variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) AND (action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring}))

panels.description: Script success rate per 30m across all user interfaces; Failed = run count (hidden by default, toggle in legend)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(er.executed_at, '30m'),
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Passed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT er.success) AS "Failed"
FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ','))) AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM script_results sr_env WHERE sr_env.id = execution_results.script_result_id AND sr_env.environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ','))))) er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (ui.name IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (er.action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

list.label: User Interface
list.name: user_interface
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ui.name FROM execution_results er LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL) AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at) AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) ORDER BY ui.name

list.description: Run scope. Empty = base run (no --variant). Each variant aggregates separately on edge_metrics — 'All' shows combined volume across scopes.
list.label: Variant
list.name: variant
list.query: SELECT 'Base' AS variant UNION SELECT name FROM userinterface_variants UNION SELECT DISTINCT variant FROM execution_results WHERE variant IS NOT NULL ORDER BY variant

list.label: Model
list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(device_model, 'unknown') AS model FROM execution_results WHERE kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.description: STB hardware model derived from device_get_info serial. Filters the stb_tv radar.
list.label: STB Model
list.name: stb_model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT SPLIT_PART(serial, '-', 2) AS model FROM (SELECT COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'serial_number_stb', metadata->'info'->>'seriennummer_stb') AS serial FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'serial_number_stb', metadata->'info'->>'seriennummer_stb') IS NOT NULL) t ORDER BY model

list.description: STB software build derived from device_get_info software_version (the PRD-..-AL core). Filters the stb_tv radar.
list.label: Software Version
list.name: software
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(software, '^.*?-MON-', ''), '-[0-9]{6,}.*$', '') AS sw FROM (SELECT COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'software_version', metadata->'info'->>'softwareversion') AS software FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'software_version', metadata->'info'->>'softwareversion') IS NOT NULL) t WHERE software LIKE '%-MON-%' ORDER BY sw

list.label: Action Set
list.name: action_set
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(lbl.kpi_name), ''), NULLIF(MAX(lbl.edge_label), ''), er.action_set_id) AS __text, er.action_set_id AS __value FROM execution_results er LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT as_elem->>'kpi_name' AS kpi_name, as_elem->>'label' AS edge_label FROM navigation_edges ne, jsonb_array_elements(ne.action_sets) AS as_elem WHERE ne.edge_id = regexp_replace(er.edge_id, '_reverse$', '') AND ne.tree_id = er.tree_id AND as_elem->>'id' = er.action_set_id LIMIT 1) lbl ON true WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL) AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at) AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY er.action_set_id ORDER BY __text

list.description: Filter by device tags set on the Device page
list.label: Tag
list.name: flag
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT f AS flag FROM device_flags, unnest(flags) f ORDER BY 1
